title: more than... 不只是.......
explanation: 我们常说“他不只是朋友而已”或“我得这个病已经超过十年了”，其中的“不只……”或“超过……”都可以用“more than...”这个句型来表示。

examples.en: I have known him for more than 20 years.
examples.note: more than之后接数词、名词、形容词或副词。more than后面接的词不同，代表的意思也不完全相同。

examples.en: He is more than a famous artist;he is a director,too.
I am more than satisfied with the job.
I was less than excited to see that the annoying neighbors were here to visit.
examples.note: 另外，与“more than＋形容词／副词”相反的句型是“less than＋形容词／副词”，意为“不、很少、不很、不到”，具有否定意义。

examples.en: He is less than happy to hear that he has lost the bet again.
